text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
“—Today too...
It will be a fierce race, won't it...?”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... runs aiming solely for victory.
There isn't a single person—who isn't completely serious.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"—No.
Because I, too... have things I seek."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Dedicated to you—a bouquet of victory.
